ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle, with a black dot inside the circle indicating the center; a line segment is drawn from the center to the circumference, labeled beside it as “3 in.”, so this line segment is the radius. Reasoning: The problem asks to find the circumference of the circle and round to the nearest tenth. The circumference formula for a circle is C = 2πr. Substituting r = 3, we get C = 2π(3) = 6π ≈ 18.8496. Rounded to the tenth is 18.8.
